newsitem.title: USA: INSTANT VIEW - U.S. March CPI up 0.1 pct, 0.2 core.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - U.S. March CPI up 0.1 pct, 0.2 core.

text.p: Following are comments from U.S. experts after the Labor Department said the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.1 percent in March compared to a 0.3-percent increase in February. Minus food and energy, the core rate was up 0.2 percent.
Experts in a Reuters poll had expected a 0.2-percent rise overall and a 0.3-percent increase in the core.
NANCY KIMELMAN, CHIEF ECONOMIST, TECHNICAL DATA: "I don't think the (Federal Reserve) was anticipating a rise in the CPI just quite yet."
